desc:
🏀 Basketball Universe — your team, your court, your game!

One of the first basketball games on Roblox to combine full-team control, head-to-head action, and teaming up with friends!

🔥 CHOOSE YOUR GAME
🧠 Control an entire team and run the floor your way.
⚔️ Play 1v1 head-to-head against another player with AI teammates on each squad.
🤝 Join Match Up with friends, each controlling a player on the same team.
🃏 Ultimate Team: Collect player cards, build the best team possible, and compete against other players!
🌟 Legacy Mode: Create your player and build your basketball career.

🎮 Controller support & mobile compatibility!
🚀 More modes, features, and updates coming soon!

⭐ Favorite the game to jump back in!
🔔 Follow for updates and announcements.
🏀 Bring your squad. Build your team. Own the court.

Tags: Basketball, Sports, Ultimate Team, Player Cards, Multiplayer, PvP, Teamwork, Console, Mobile
